newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak bourse steady on mixed blue chips.
newsitem.headline: Slovak bourse steady on mixed blue chips.

text.p: Slovak blue chips closed mixed in thin trading on the Bratislava Stock Exchange (BSE) on Monday, leaving the 16-share SAX index 0.07 points lower at 193.73.
Brokers said the bourse remained illiquid, with only a few blue chips, such as steel maker VSZ, trading moderate volumes.
"Now it seems to be a non-stop stagnation," Peter Lachkovic of Slovenska Sporitelna said.
VSZ closed up one crown at 741, on 768 traded shares, with Lachkovic expecting the share to rise further after the company proposed a 40-crown dividend on 1996 profits.
"I think it still has potential to rise," he said.
Overall, volume eased to 256,153 shares, from 295,031 shares traded on Friday, while turnover fell to 56.47 million crowns, from 243.93 million.
